newsitem.title: USA: Montana Pwr Colstrip unit restart delayed.
newsitem.headline: Montana Pwr Colstrip unit restart delayed.

text.p: The 700 MW unit 4 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant, located 110 miles northeast of Billings, Montana, will not be restarted until Thursday, a spokesman for plant operator Montana Power Co said Monday.
The 700 MW unit 4 was shut early Saturday morning for repairs and had been expected to restart late Sunday, but more extensive repairs were needed, the spokesman said.
Colstrip's 320 megawatt (MW) unit 2, which was taken off line Thursday to repair a boiler tube leak, was restarted as planned over the weekend, spokesman Cort Freeman said.
Colstrip's other two units, one at 330 MW and another at 700 MW, were operating normally, he noted.
